sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Do not use invented TRF049_* shape IRIs in the canonical vocabulary namespace; replace them with blank-node or non-vocabulary shape identifiers. Preserve the prior universal requirement: add or locate the canonical generic frame-to-supporting-structure relationship/path needed to enumerate every supporting structure for each in-area frame, then require a paired frame attachment, hasAttachedSupportingStructure link, reciprocal hasSupportingStructureAttachment link, and effectiveAttachmentConfirmed=true for each pair. The current SupportingStructureShape incorrectly targets every supportingStructure globally and requires an attachment without tying it to the applicable frame; remove or redesign it under the frame-specific applicability path.
